summary.headline: Strength of the Lord of the Year
summary.text: Chapter XIII explains how aspects to the lord of the year indicate strength, weakness, discord, friendship, and sources of impediment involving the king or peasants. Chapter XIV begins discussion of the king’s adversary, identifying enmity through the house occupied by an evil planet and testimonies of the king’s significator or lord of the year.
